rules.title: Water on Carriageway
rules.message: Standing water depth of {value:.2f}m detected on road surface. Free flow speed reduced by ~15-25%.

rules.title: Severe Road Disruption
rules.message: Water depth reached {value:.2f}m (exceeds threshold 0.25m). Small passenger vehicles stalled; lane capacity reduced by ~50%.

rules.title: Road Impassable / Total Closure
rules.message: Critical water depth of {value:.2f}m. Road impassable for standard traffic; emergency heavy vehicles only.
